    stack = []
    visited.add(start)
    stack.append({start})
    seen = set()
    while stack:
        path = stack.pop()
        current = path[-1]
        if current == goal:
            return path
        seen.add(current)
        for neighbor in graph[current]:
            if neighbor not in visited:
                new_path = path.copy()
                new_path.append(neighbor)
                stack.append(new_path)
